basis: Skin ulceration, osteolysis and oligodontia define syndrome; damaging keratitis occurred in 3/5 reported siblings.
Disease of pulmonary arteries with right ventricular remodeling; pulmonary vascular disease does not establish lung parenchymal damage.
Developmental epileptic encephalopathy with brain atrophy and hypomyelination; reflux is a separately diagnosed associated condition.
Glycosphingolipid biosynthesis disorder with severe epileptic neurodevelopmental disease; hearing impairment is under 30%; ocular damage frequency unclear.
Myofibrillar muscle degeneration; peripheral neuropathy occurs in 80-99%. Cardiomyopathy and respiratory insufficiency occur in under 30%.
Umbrella disease category defined by respiratory system involvement; no shared infectious or other systemic mechanism.
Genetically associated immune-mediated inflammatory bowel disease; no established common extraintestinal damage in this record.
Definition identifies a connective tissue neoplasm without a specified organ site; meningeal or pleural origin cannot be assumed.
Neoplasm arising in the urethra, which belongs to the urinary axis.
Lethal arteriopathy defined by arterial disease; no evidence here establishes common damage to additional organs.
Congenital terminal absence of part of the arm is a structural limb defect.
Non-syndromic congenital malformation of digits; other congenital anomalies are not established as common.
Endometrial carcinoma extending into cervical stroma remains confined to reproductive organs.
Congenital failure of neural tube closure affecting brain or spinal cord; additional organ damage is not shared across the umbrella.
Hair, liver and brain define syndrome; hip dysplasia/dislocation in 67-100%. Recurrent otitis, ocular abnormalities and PDA omitted by four-axis cap.
Inherited prion encephalopathy; prion disease supplies the infectious mechanism axis. Autonomic signs do not establish separate organ damage.
Hantavirus disease defined by renal injury and hemorrhagic dysfunction; direct endothelial dysfunction with capillary leak occurs in 80-99%.
Malignant neoplasm originating in a salivary gland; salivary glands belong to the gastrointestinal axis.
Adenoviral infection umbrella includes respiratory, ocular, intestinal and urinary presentations; common damaging involvement of one site is not established.
Melanoma arises from leptomeningeal melanocytes in the central nervous system; melanocytic lineage does not imply skin involvement.
Eosinophilic meningeal inflammation is predominantly infectious, usually helminthic; CSF eosinophilia does not establish blood disease.
Immune-mediated fibrillary glomerular deposits cause renal insufficiency, hematuria and proteinuria.
Vaginal inflammation is confined to a reproductive organ; this umbrella explicitly includes noninfectious disease and does not establish an infectious mechanism.
Defined enzyme-activity disorder with a metabolic disease parent; no specific neurologic damage or frequency is supplied.
Passively transferred maternal antibodies impair neuromuscular junction transmission; respiratory and swallowing weakness do not establish lung or gut damage.
